name: uci iris dummy stratified reference baseline

accuracy.description: Fraction of held-out Iris instances classified correctly.

macro_f1.description: Unweighted mean F1 over the three Iris classes.

seed_policy: Frozen split file defines train/test membership; dummy_stratified uses deterministic feature hashing to match training class proportions without runtime randomness.
notes: Reference baseline approximates a stratified dummy classifier with deterministic feature hashing and training-set class proportions.
role=other keeps this broader baseline out of the primary candidate-vs-knn3 statistics while preserving executable result and artifact provenance.
Official source and license must be rechecked before formal manuscript submission.
